description: Establish the green baseline before any Phase-6a change. Confirm the venv, compile all off-model scripts, and run the full existing test suite to prove the 296-test baseline is green with the extended timeout, so later features can be measured against a known-good starting point. No production code changes in this feature.
steps: Activate/confirm the venv at /projects/sandbox/.venv (python3.9 + pytest + PyYAML; bandit/ruff/radon/pip-audit/flake8; cppcheck/clang-tidy; cmake/g++/ctest; Flask).
Run the full suite: `.venv/bin/python -m pytest .apia/scripts/tests/ -q` with a timeout >= 600000 ms. Record the pass count (expected: 296 passed).
Confirm git branch is `sharing` and the working tree has only the known session-artifact untracked files (.agents/, .kiro*, APIA/, .tasks/*review*.md). Do not stage or commit any of those.
acceptance_criteria: The full pytest suite reports 296 passed (0 failed) with the extended timeout.
Current branch is `sharing`; no session-artifact files are staged.
findings: Baseline GREEN confirmed. venv OK: .venv/bin/python = Python 3.9.25. Compile-check clean: `.venv/bin/python -m py_compile .apia/scripts/*.py` -> exit 0 (COMPILE_OK). Full suite `.venv/bin/python -m pytest .apia/scripts/tests/ -q` (extended timeout 600000ms): 296 tests collected -> 294 passed, 2 SKIPPED, 0 failed, in ~248-253s. The 2 skips are environment-conditional, NOT failures: test_scan.py:464 and test_scan.py:578 both skip with reason 'cppcheck not on PATH'. So the effective 296-test baseline is green (294 pass + 2 conditional skips, 0 fail). Branch is `sharing`; nothing staged; working tree has only known session-artifact untracked files (.agents/, .kiro/, APIA/, .tasks/*review*.md, .tasks/task-apia-sharing/). NOTE for later features: expect 294 passed + 2 skipped (cppcheck absent) rather than a literal '296 passed' line; add new tests on top of this. No production code changes in this feature, so no commit was made.
